name: Jitterflow Developer
free_limit: 10,000 webhooks/month; 5 requests/second; 3 endpoints; 256 KB payloads
watch_out: 3-day dead-letter queue and payload log retention; hard monthly cap; side projects and low-volume production.

name: Tigris Object Storage Free
free_limit: 5 GiB Standard storage/month; 10,000 Class A and 100,000 Class B requests/month; free egress
watch_out: Over-quota usage billed; non-Standard storage and object notifications may incur charges; card and commercial eligibility unconfirmed.

name: Cloudinary Free
free_limit: 25 credits per rolling 30 days shared across transformations, storage and bandwidth; 3 users
watch_out: 1 credit equals 1,000 transformations OR 1 GB storage OR 1 GB delivery; credits combine all usage; overage can disable account after warnings; paid add-ons separate.

name: DIPSAC Free API
free_limit: 500 API requests/month; 2 requests/second; 5 MB files; 1 API key
watch_out: Free API excludes audio/video endpoints; monthly overages return HTTP 429; commercial use unconfirmed.

name: Railhook Cloud Free
free_limit: 10,000 events/month; 3 projects; 5 endpoints/project; 7-day history
watch_out: Requests over monthly quota are rejected; hosted cloud commercial-use terms unconfirmed.

name: Belmo Starter
free_limit: 1 always-on service; 0.5 shared vCPU; 512 MB RAM; SSL; 30-day logs
watch_out: No custom domain on Starter, only belmo.io subdomain; commercial terms unconfirmed.

name: Langfuse Cloud Hobby
free_limit: 50,000 billable units/month; 30-day data access; 2 users
watch_out: Free tier is intended for hobby projects and POCs; longer retention and production support require paid plans; commercial terms unconfirmed.

name: UploadThing 2GB App
free_limit: 2 GB storage shared across apps; unlimited uploads/downloads; 7-day audit logs
watch_out: Private files and configurable storage regions require paid plans; card and commercial-use terms unconfirmed.

name: Mailtrap Email API/SMTP Free
free_limit: 4,000 emails/month; 150 emails/day; 1 sending domain; API and SMTP relay; 3-day logs
watch_out: No additional email sends on Free; marketing and sandbox plans are separate; explicit commercial-use terms not confirmed.

name: EmailOctopus Starter
free_limit: 2,500 subscribers; 10,000 emails/month; 1 user; 3 automations; 1 landing page and 1 form
watch_out: EmailOctopus branding and rewards link required; 30-day reports; 5 steps per automation; subscriber consent required.

name: Logto Cloud Free
free_limit: Up to 50,000 monthly active users; 50,000 access tokens/month; 3 applications; 1 machine-to-machine app; 1 custom domain
watch_out: Token allowance can constrain effective MAU; Pro is positioned for production and teams. Free excludes RBAC, organizations, MFA, enterprise SSO, passkeys and custom sign-in UI. Commercial-use permission not confirmed.

name: Atlassian Statuspage Free
free_limit: Up to 2 public pages per organization; 100 subscribers, 25 components, 2 team members, 2 metrics; email/Slack/Teams notifications and rate-limited REST API
watch_out: Free plan is only for public status pages; private pages and custom domains require paid plans. Credit-card requirement and commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

name: Helicone Hobby
free_limit: 10,000 requests/month; 1 GB storage; 1 seat and 1 organization; 7-day data retention
watch_out: Free tier ingests up to 10 logs/minute; API access, alerts, and longer retention require paid plans. Homepage mentions a 7-day trial for premium features; card requirement and commercial-use rights for Hobby need confirmation.

name: Rollbar Free
free_limit: 5,000 error occurrences/month; 1,000 session replays/month; 30-day data retention; unlimited users and projects
watch_out: 14-day Advanced trial is separate from the ongoing Free tier; 0 AI credits on Free; processing stops at the monthly limit by default.

name: Snyk Free
free_limit: 5 projects; monthly limits: 200 Open Source tests, 100 Code tests, 300 IaC tests and 100 Container tests
watch_out: Designed for individual developers and small teams; private-repository scan quotas are enforced and recurring free-plan scans run weekly; commercial-use terms not explicitly confirmed.

name: Permit.io Community
free_limit: 1,000 monthly active users; 20 tenants; unlimited authorization queries; 3 environments; 25 roles
watch_out: Single deployment region; 14-day log retention; best-effort cloud uptime/support; enterprise compliance and SSO not included. Commercial-use terms not explicitly confirmed.

name: Pusher Channels Sandbox
free_limit: 200,000 messages per day; 100 concurrent connections; standard support; hosted realtime pub/sub channels
watch_out: A published message and its deliveries to subscribed clients each count toward the daily quota. Sandbox is intended for prototypes and small production apps; no Sandbox SLA. Official signup credit-card requirement not confirmed.

name: Courier Developer
free_limit: 10,000 notification sends/month; Journeys and broadcasts; SDKs, CLI and MCP server; Google and GitHub SSO
watch_out: Beyond the free monthly allowance, Business pricing is $0.005 per send; downstream email/SMS provider charges may apply. Credit-card requirement and explicit commercial-use terms for Developer not confirmed.

name: Mailjet Free
free_limit: 6,000 emails/month; 200 emails/day; up to 1,000 contacts; API, SMTP relay and event webhooks
watch_out: Free support is limited to the first month; daily cap applies and advanced features or removal of branding require a paid plan. Explicit commercial-use terms for Free are unconfirmed.

name: Arcjet Free
free_limit: 10,000 security requests/month after the 15-day trial; SDK-based web and agent runtime protection
watch_out: A 15-day trial precedes the ongoing capped Free plan; paid Individual is $25/month plus usage. Free plan features, credit-card signup requirement, and commercial-use terms need confirmation.

name: Composio Hobby
free_limit: 100,000 tool calls/month and 50,000 trigger events/month using your own OAuth app, API key or MCP; 3 team members; unlimited connected accounts; 1 million sandbox LLM tokens/month
watch_out: Composio-managed apps have smaller included allowances (20,000 tool calls and 10,000 trigger events/month); third-party provider and Instant Tool charges may apply separately; Hobby pauses at its usage cap. Commercial-use terms not independently confirmed.

name: MemCachier Developer
free_limit: 25 MB fully managed Memcached cache; 1 proxy server; 10 connections; basic analytics and 24/7 monitoring
watch_out: Developer tier is aimed at development; high availability, alerting and unlimited connections require paid plans. Free-signup card requirement and commercial production rights are unconfirmed; unauthorized resale is prohibited.

name: Beeceptor Free
free_limit: 50 requests/day per public endpoint; 3 mock rules; 10 small CRUD objects; dynamic and conditional responses; ephemeral local tunnel
watch_out: Free endpoints are public, with no SLA. Unclaimed endpoints are automatically deleted (official pages differ between 7 and 30 days); claimed endpoints expire 90 days after creation. Do not send sensitive payloads.

name: CloudAMQP Little Lemur
free_limit: Shared RabbitMQ broker; 1,000,000 messages/month; 20 connections; up to 100 queues and 10,000 queued messages
watch_out: Free plan is intended for development; maximum idle queue time is 28 days. Free instances without published or consumed messages for two months are deleted after warning. Commercial production suitability not independently confirmed.

name: Redis Cloud Free
free_limit: One free Redis Cloud database per account; 30 MB memory; 30 concurrent connections; 5 GB monthly network bandwidth; up to 100 operations/second (1 KiB requests)
watch_out: Free Essentials is intended for learning and prototypes; shared deployment, best-effort SLA and community support. Network and throughput quotas apply; commercial production rights are not explicitly confirmed.
